MEDIATOR_SKIP_LIST._______ATTENTION!______: ALWAYS validate your modifications in this JSON here: https://jsonlint.com/. If it's invalid, the Mediator will break and die.
MEDIATOR_SKIP_LIST._documentation: Instructions: to prevent a dependent DAG to be triggered by the mediator, you can update its date to the CURRENT DATE. Then the Mediator will ignore in following executions of the given date. You don't need to duplicate a key, if your DAG is already registered, ***DO NOT DUPLICATE THE ENTRY***.
